stance_basis: mentioned only as a participating governmental entity and data source, no position expressed
summary: The City of Los Angeles is referenced throughout the document window as a key governmental participant in the Regional Transportation Development Program and as a source of planning data (traffic, land use, population/employment statistics). The City is listed among the agencies to receive copies of the draft report and is noted as the proponent of the separate Downtown People Mover Project. No distinct position for or against any of the transit alternatives is expressed by the City in this window.
